Title: Lab Reports export headers do not match UI table headers
Preconditions: User logged in as team40 and on Lab Reports list view
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open https://team40.qaaerp.com 2. Login with ID team40 and password vASPFtSh4d 3. Navigate to Lab Reports from dashboard/menu 4. Select the header checkbox 5. Click Actions (gear icon) 6. Click Export All 7. Open downloaded file: Lab Report (healthplix.lab.report).xlsx 8. Compare exported header row with UI table headers
Expected Result: Exported file column headers should exactly match Lab Reports UI headers.
Actual Result: Header names differ between UI and export. UI headers: Ref, Patient, Date, Test Type, Doctor, Lab, Status. Export headers: Report Ref, Patient, Report Date, Test Type, Doctor, Lab Name, Status. Mismatched headers: Ref ↔ Report Ref; Date ↔ Report Date; Lab ↔ Lab Name.
Evidence: UI snapshot (Lab Reports list header row): Ref|Patient|Date|Test Type|Doctor|Lab|Status. Export header extraction from downloaded file first row: Report Ref|Patient|Report Date|Test Type|Doctor|Lab Name|Status. Network evidence: export triggered via POST /web/export/xlsx (200).
